keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Tobias Guddal (Sparta Prague) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Penalty missed! Still Sparta Prague 0, Bournemouth 0. Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) hits the left post with a right footed shot.
Ki-Jana Hoever (Sparta Prague) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! Sparta Prague 1, Bournemouth 0. Ebrima Singhateh (Sparta Prague) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Jakub Surovcík following a fast break.
Second yellow card to Tobias Guddal (Sparta Prague) for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Sparta Prague 1, Bournemouth 0.
Substitution, Sparta Prague. Jaroslav Zeleny replaces Jonatan Braut Brunes.
Substitution, Bournemouth. Tyler Adams replaces Adam Smith.
Amine Adli (Bournemouth) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Sivert Mannsverk (Sparta Prague).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Sparta Prague 1, Bournemouth 1. Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner.
Substitution, Bournemouth. Adrien Truffert replaces Julio Soler.
Substitution, Bournemouth. Marcus Tavernier replaces Ben Gannon-Doak.
Substitution, Bournemouth. Evanilson replaces Amine Adli.
Substitution, Sparta Prague. Matej Jurásek replaces Andy Irving.
Substitution, Bournemouth. Rayan replaces David Brooks.
Delay in match because of an injury Ebrima Singhateh (Sparta Prague).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match (Bournemouth).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Sparta Prague. Santiago Eneme replaces Ebrima Singhateh.
Substitution, Sparta Prague. Hugo Sochurek replaces Josimar Alcócer.
Goal! Sparta Prague 1, Bournemouth 2. Evanilson (Bournemouth) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Ryan Christie.
Matej Jurásek (Sparta Prague) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Sparta Prague. Matyás Vojta replaces Roman Macek.
Goal! Sparta Prague 1, Bournemouth 3. Rayan (Bournemouth) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Evanilson.
